name: Dongyangopelta
sum: Dongyangopelta is a nodosaurid from the Chaochuan Formation of Zhejiang, China, described from a partial postcranial skeleton.
holotype: Partial postcranial skeleton with osteoderms and ossified tendons — Chaochuan Formation, Yangyan Village, Dongyang, Zhejiang.
material: Holotype only; found in 2009 and excavated in 2010.
biology: Known from armour and ossified tendons; no behavioural data.
author: Chen et al. 2013

sources.text: Rongjun Chen 2013. A New Nodosaurid Ankylosaur from the Chaochuan Formation of Dongyang, Zhejiang Province, China. Acta Geologica Sinica (English Edition) 87(3): 658–671. doi:10.1111/1755-6724.12077
